parameters.functionCode:
// Builds the ghostwriter brief sent to OpenAI (system = who writes, user = what to write).
var row = items[0].json;
var topic = (row.Topic || '').trim();
var tone = row.Tone || 'professional, confident and warm';
var audience = row.Audience || 'software engineers, tech leads and engineering managers';

var system = [
  'You are an elite LinkedIn ghostwriter for a senior software engineer who writes about',
  '.NET, system design, distributed systems, cloud, AI and engineering leadership.',
  'Your posts are the kind experienced engineers save and share: clear, specific,',
  'confident and human. You explain hard ideas simply, with the calm authority of',
  'someone who has run systems in production. You never sound like marketing copy',
  'or like an AI.'
].join('\n');

var prompt = [
  'Write one LinkedIn post.',
  '',
  'Topic: ' + topic,
  'Tone: ' + tone,
  'Audience: ' + audience,
  '',
  'STRUCTURE (keep this order, one blank line between every block):',
  '',
  '1. HOOK - the first 1-2 lines, under 180 characters in total. This is all that',
  '   shows before "...see more", so it must earn the click. Start with one fitting',
  '   emoji, then a sharp claim, a common mistake, or a surprising truth about the',
  '   topic. Do not open with a question, a definition, an analogy, or',
  '   "Let\'s talk about", and do not restate the topic title. Make it specific and',
  '   a little bold, like: "🧊 Your cache is not making your API fast. It is hiding',
  '   a slow one." Pick an emoji that fits the topic, not 🚀 by default.',
  '',
  '2. WHY IT MATTERS - 2-3 short lines: what it is in plain words and what goes',
  '   wrong in real systems when people get it wrong.',
  '',
  '3. "🏗️ Real-world example:" - one concrete, relatable scenario (an e-commerce',
  '   checkout, a payments API, a ride-hailing app, a team under deadline...).',
  '   Walk through it in 3-4 lines, each starting with "→ ".',
  '',
  '4. "✅ Do this:" - 3 practical, specific recommendations, each one line',
  '   starting with "▸ ". Each must be concrete enough to apply tomorrow: name the',
  '   exact pattern, API, setting or number (e.g. cache-aside, HybridCache, TTL with',
  '   jitter, idempotency keys, p99 latency). No generic advice like "monitor it".',
  '',
  '5. "⚠️ Watch out:" - 2 trade-offs or pitfalls, each one line starting with "▸ ".',
  '',
  '6. "💡 Bottom line:" - one memorable sentence that captures the core trade-off.',
  '',
  '7. "💬 " followed by one specific, opinion-inviting question for the audience',
  '   (not "What do you think?").',
  '',
  '8. Last line: 4-5 relevant hashtags in PascalCase, e.g. #SystemDesign #DotNet.',
  '',
  'STYLE RULES:',
  '- 1,200-1,900 characters in total.',
  '- Short lines. No paragraph longer than 2 sentences. Lots of white space.',
  '- Use "you" and active voice. Plain, precise words over jargon.',
  '- Every line must teach something or move the story. Cut filler and hedging.',
  '- Emojis only as the section markers above, plus the one in the hook.',
  '- Plain text only: no markdown, no **bold**, no # headings, no code blocks,',
  '  no links. LinkedIn does not render markdown.',
  '- Do not invent personal stories, employers, statistics, studies or quotes.',
  '  Examples must read as illustrations, not as claims of real events.',
  '- Never use: "In today\'s fast-paced world", "game-changer", "delve", "unlock",',
  '  "leverage", "landscape", "revolutionize", "buckle up", "let that sink in",',
  '  "here\'s the thing", "in conclusion", "crucial", "critical", "robust",',
  '  "seamless", "world of hurt", "make or break", "saves the day", "harness".',
  '- No trailing spaces at the end of lines.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY the post text, nothing before or after it.'
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { system: system, prompt: prompt } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: "gpt-4o", temperature: 0.75, max_tokens: 1200, messages: [ { role: "system", content: $json.system }, { role: "user", content: $json.prompt } ] } }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ ({ "status": "done", "message": ($json._reason || "No topics found in CSV") + ". Add new rows to topics.csv and push to develop." }) }}
